content:
Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly:

* Format all [[variable names]].

* Format ".", "<" and ">" as {{constants}}.

I'll perform a more detailed review tomorrow.

~ Input ~
- Please at line 1 remove the comma "," and rewrite the last part as "for the height of the board.".
- Please rewrite line 2 as "a string consisting of {{.}} and one digit [[N]] in the drop column for the stack line".

~ Output ~
- Please reformat as <<[[N]] lines:>>.
- Please capitalize "The" after "lines: ".
- I ~think~ the 0 after "numbered from 0" is better formatted as {{constant}}, but I'm not sure.

Goal / Output
* In the first paragraph, consider formatting "drop column" and "number of balls" in <<bold>>.

* "The ball then falls to the next row: the cell in its new column is not checked on the same row": The sentence was a bit hard to understand. Consider rewording it as:

The ball then falls immediately to the next row, regardless of whether its column changes or not. Its movement is not affected by another peg in the same row.

* The final sentence of the example is too simplified and ignores that Ball 2 also flipped a peg, affecting the path taken by Ball 3. Please replace it with:

Ball 1 flipped two pegs and exited down column 2.
Ball 2 flipped one peg and exited down column 3.
Ball 3 flipped two pegs and exited down column 0. 

* Please insert "Columns are numbered from {{0}}." as the second paragraph of the Goal section.

* After that, remove ", columns numbered from 0" from the example.

* Also remove "Columns are numbered from 0" from the Output section.

Input
* Line 2: Please change "The" to "A string for the".

* Next H line: Please change "made of" to "containing".

Output
* Please change "[[N]] lines:" to "<<[[N]] lines:>> An integer for". Note the <<bold>> format.

* Please add "on its own line" after "each ball".

Stub generator
* Lines 2 & 11: Please change "stock" to "stack".

Cases
* Test 2: Please remove the trailing newline from the output.

* Please insert a pair of cases with [[H]] around 10, where pegs fill the entire board except for the first column, the last column and the drop column.

Thanks.
